entities.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Kigoma is a diocese located in Kigoma in the ecclesiastical province of Tabora in Tanzania. Because of the appointment of Bishop Protase Rugambwa as an Archbishop ad personam by Pope Benedict XVI on Tuesday, June 26, 2012, the Diocese became a vacant see.
